_comment: Build config for the Prometheus service, which uses this directory as its Railway Root
Directory. Without this file Railway finds no Dockerfile at the root of the build context,
falls back to Railpack's language auto-detection, and fails trying to make sense of a
directory of YAML -- which is exactly how the first deploy of that service failed.
dockerfilePath is relative to the service's Root Directory, not the repository root. That is
not inferred from the docs: backend/railway.json says "Dockerfile" and resolves to
backend/Dockerfile against a Root Directory of backend/, in a service that has been deploying
this way in production for months.
The Dockerfile deliberately stays in railway/prometheus/ rather than moving up here. A second
service in this directory later (Grafana is the obvious one) needs its own Dockerfile, and two
of them cannot both be ops/monitoring/Dockerfile.
No healthcheckPath, unlike backend/railway.json. Prometheus does serve /-/healthy, but this
service has no public domain by design and whether Railway's healthcheck reaches an unexposed
service is not something this repository has tested. An untested healthcheck that cannot be
reached does not report a problem -- it fails every deploy.
